name: Bearings
description: Places a sound on a plane in front of you and moves it there: pan, distance (level, air, room and a touch of Doppler) and real head cues, with circle, figure 8, pendulum, ping-pong, drift, tide, step and scatter paths locked to the song, a loudness follower, a Throw control and a three-band split mode.
author: Groundswell
